# reports

Scan reports, drill-down pages, imports and exports.

- Toolset name: `reports`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 18 (15 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_cancel_job`

**Cancel job** · destructive

Cancel an asynchronous job you created.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_delete_report`

**Delete report** · destructive

Permanently delete a scan report (reports have no trashcan). The task itself is not affected.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_download_job_result`

**Download job result** · read-only

Download the artifact of a succeeded export job. JSON exports are returned inline; binary formats (PDF, XML, CSV…) are returned as base64. Both are capped at 3 MB — for larger artifacts, export with a narrower filter or page through the results instead.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_export_report`

**Export report** · read-only

Start an asynchronous report export. Returns a job (usually `queued`); poll it with openvas_get_job, then fetch the artifact with openvas_download_job_result once the status is `succeeded`. Jobs and artifacts expire ~15 minutes after completion; keep polling at least every few minutes, since an idle job session is closed by the gateway.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | Optional GMP filter expression applied during generation |
| `filter_id` | string | no | Optional saved filter UUID applied during generation |
| `id` | string | yes | Report UUID |
| `report_config_id` | string | no | Optional report configuration UUID (gvmd report formats only) |
| `report_format_id` | string | no | UUID of a gvmd report format (see openvas_list_report_formats). Omit to request the gateway's native JSON export. |

### `openvas_get_job`

**Get job status** · read-only

Get the status of an asynchronous job (queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelling, cancelled or expired).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_get_report`

**Get report** · read-only

Get one scan report by UUID: task, timing, severity, result counts and one page of embedded results (`page`/`per_page`).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Report UUID |
| `page` | integer | no | Page of embedded results to include (1-indexed) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Embedded results per page (1-1000) (min 0) |

### `openvas_get_report_applications`

**Report applications** · read-only

List the applications (CPEs) detected in one report.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `id` | string | yes | Report UUID |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_import_report`

**Import report** · mutating

Import a GMP XML report into an existing import task. Returns the new report's UUID.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `in_assets` | boolean | no | Whether hosts from the report are added to assets (omit for the backend default) |
| `report_xml` | string | yes | One complete GMP XML report envelope (`<report>…</report>`), at most 10 MiB |
| `task_id` | string | yes | UUID of an existing import task (create one with openvas_create_task and `type: "import"`) |
